research_target: Identify when early learning and transfer signals fail to predict remaining-budget gains, then test whether a cheap correction improves actual allocation

first_packet.purpose: Small prospective replication and decision-scope audit, not final independent confirmation of an allocation algorithm
first_packet.seed_labels: Assign unused original and continuation streams before implementation; do not reuse original 11/12/13 or 901 as new originals

outcome_evaluation.case_pairing: Fresh cases shared across conditions within each parent, disjoint from training and historical evaluation banks
outcome_evaluation.use: Research outcome only; not used for policy selection, parent filtering, checkpoint choice, or early stopping

screening_gate_proposal.meaning: Operational prioritization rule only; not statistical significance, power guarantee, or a final scientific confirmation criterion

first_packet.execution_rule: Run every predeclared cell and retain adverse outcomes; scientific effect direction does not change the sample count

later_stages: Directly measure early-to-final prediction failures on the same actual continuations, with D/O separation and whole-original-seed holdout
For switching claims, branch alternatives from the same full diagnostic checkpoint; do not splice separately trained trajectories
Freeze a small selection/correction rule and compare on fresh original seeds with all diagnostic environment costs included
Check A/C, then unseen task families or another benchmark before broad generalization claims
